name: Treemap
summary: Squarified treemap of a hierarchy — area = value, colour = top-level group or a metric such as growth; drill down with a breadcrumb.
summary_zh: 层级结构的矩形树图：面积代表数值，颜色代表一级分组或某个指标（如增长率），点击下钻并通过面包屑返回。
description_zh: 用面积展示层级构成，例如集团 > 业务板块 > 产品线的收入结构，或细分市场 > 竞争者的市场规模。数据可以是 id / parent 一行一个节点的树表（父节点数值自动取子节点之和），也可以是平表加 encode.path 字段列表（如 [segment, player]）。颜色可按一级分组区分，也可按指标（如增长率）用发散色阶着色，中点可设为 0 或加权平均值，从而一眼看出“哪块大、哪块增长快”。点击分组下钻、面包屑返回，在当前层点击叶子节点交叉筛选其他图表。
best_for: Revenue by segment and product line
Market size by segment and player
Size vs. growth at a glance (colour by growth)
avoid_when: Fewer than ~4 parts (use a donut or bar)
Precise comparison of similar-sized items is required (use a bar)

parent.desc: Parent node id; '' or missing for the root

name.desc: Node label (id / parent mode); also the cross-filter field

value.desc: Size of each leaf (parents are summed)

path.desc: Flat data: hierarchy fields from top to leaf, e.g. ['segment', 'player'] (overrides id / parent)

color.desc: Metric for diverging colour, e.g. growth (parents use their own value or the value-weighted average)

colorBy.desc: auto | group | metric — auto = metric when encode.color is set

colorMid.desc: Midpoint of the diverging metric scale: a number or 'avg' (value-weighted average)

sort.desc: desc | asc — order in which cells are squarified

labels.desc: auto (name + value + metric) | name | value | none

showShare.desc: Add the % of total to leaf labels

drill.desc: Click a group to zoom in; breadcrumb navigates back

rootName.desc: Breadcrumb root label (defaults to the single root node, else 'Total')

highlight.desc: Node name(s) outlined in the accent colour (e.g. the client)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

metricFormat.desc: Metric format; defaults to the color field format

interactions: Hover tooltip with value, % of total, % of parent and metric
Click a group (or a cell of another group) to drill down; breadcrumb to go back
Click a leaf in the current view to cross-filter (non-selected leaves fade)
Animated re-layout when filters change; drill level is kept
